$schema_note: Seed manifest for a target estate. Copy to the estate root or .claude/, then: populate author_registry, adjust lexicons by PR, register your ObjectVocab, and enumerate exemptions from the first audit run. The exemptions array may only shrink.
author_registry_note: Flat list of plain strings only, e.g. ["kim.granlund", "jane"] — one entry per estate committer, matching the value each artifact's own frontmatter `author` field carries. A structured entry (e.g. {"name": ..., "emails": [...]}) is NOT supported and fails the validator cleanly (issue #252) rather than silently guessing which field is the author.
